title: DOW-UAP-PR104, Unresolved UAP Report, Yellow Sea, 2025
what_is_it: A public release record for an 18-second infrared video clip of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), with an accompanying written video description.
interpretation_warnings: The 'six-pointed star' shape is an artefact of an infrared sensor and its focus/optics, not necessarily the true shape of any object.
The case remains unresolved; no identification, origin, or explanation is offered.
The government's own notice states the description is not an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination about the event's validity, nature, or significance.
Only 18 seconds of single-sensor footage is provided, with no corroborating data, radar, or witness accounts in the source.
No PDF body text was available; the extraction relies almost entirely on war.gov metadata and the short video description.

key_facts.source_quote: from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2025
